homepage.title: Can You Pass This Bible Challenge?
homepage.summary: From famous stories to parables, places, and careful clues, see how much of the Bible you remember.

footer.aboutText: This Bible Challenge is designed for entertainment and self-testing. It is not an official religious exam, theological assessment, church qualification, spiritual evaluation, or statement of belief. The quiz uses broad Bible knowledge questions and simplified summaries.

landing.quickStartText: Start with familiar stories, then test people, places, books, parables, and timeline clues.

stageGroups.title: Bible Warm Up
stageGroups.encouragement: Good start. Your first Bible round is locked in.

questions.prompt: In the opening Bible story, what is created first?
Which person is most linked with leading the Israelites out of Egypt?
Which came first: Noah's ark or the birth of Jesus?
choices: They happen at the same time
The Bible does not mention either

questions.prompt: Remember this pair for later: Bethlehem = Birthplace. Which word is paired with Bethlehem?
In the Noah story, what large object is Noah told to build?
Which person is widely linked with being a shepherd and later a king?
Which belongs earlier in the Bible story: the Garden of Eden or Paul's journeys?
Which item does not belong with Bible places?
Remember this pair for later: Jericho = Walls. Which word is paired with Jericho?
Which story is most linked with Jonah?

stageGroups.title: Stories, People And Places
stageGroups.encouragement: Nice work. The final round mixes books, parables, and careful clues.

questions.prompt: Which story is most linked with Daniel?
Which person is strongly linked with a promise of a large family?
Which place is most linked with a river where Jesus was baptized?
Which came first: Moses leading the Exodus or David becoming king?
A clue says a man built a large boat before a flood. Which answer is safest?
choices: The clue proves the boat was in Jerusalem

questions.prompt: Which story tells of a stranger helping a hurt traveler?
Which person is named as the mother of Jesus?
Which place is widely linked with where Jesus grew up?
Which person is most linked with wisdom and many sayings?
Which place is linked with Moses receiving commandments?

stageGroups.title: Final Bible Challenge
stageGroups.encouragement: All answers are locked in. Your results are ready.

questions.prompt: Which place is most linked with a lake and many stories about Jesus?
Which person was one of Jesus' disciples and is often linked with fishing?
Which story is linked with Moses and the Red Sea?
choices: The visit of the wise men

questions.prompt: Which came later: the Exodus or Jesus teaching in Galilee?
choices: They happen at the same time

questions.prompt: Which book is in the New Testament?
Which came first in Bible order: Genesis or Acts?
Which book comes at the beginning of the Bible?
Which item is not a Bible book?
Which book is widely known for songs and prayers?
Which parable is about helping a traveler in need?
